title: Area Unlocks the Missing Side
topic: Finding a missing side from area; combining rectangle areas

items.prompt: A rectangle has an area of 72 square units and one side of 8 units. What is the length of the other side?
A square has an area of 49 square units. What is the length of one side?
items.rationale: A square's area = side x side, so the side length is the square root of the area: sqrt(49) = 7.

items.prompt: If Area = length x width, and you know the area and one side, how do you find the missing side?

choices.A: Multiply the area by the known side
choices.B: Divide the area by the known side
choices.C: Add the area and the known side
choices.D: Subtract the known side from the area

items.rationale: Since Area = length x width, missing side = Area / known side.

items.prompt: An L-shaped floor is split into two rectangles. What should you do with the two rectangle areas to find the total area?

choices.C: Subtract the smaller from the larger

items.rationale: When a figure is decomposed into non-overlapping pieces, their areas add up to the total area.

items.prompt: An L-shaped room is split into two rectangles with areas 30 square units and 18 square units. What is the total area?
